description: This file defines the DataValidation class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, encapsulating data validation parameters such as types, operators, error styles, and associated formulas. It includes methods for setting and retrieving these properties, as well as generating a hash code for the object.

classes.name: DataValidation
classes.description: A class that manages data validation rules and settings for spreadsheet cells in PhpSpreadsheet.
